equations.role: Definition 1: squared compression error bounded by (1-gamma) times squared input norm; not convergence proof
Client and server quantized updates defined as Q of corresponding pre-quantization updates

equations.issue: Residual subtracts Q(pre-quantization update) from the quantized update itself; substituting Eq 4 makes it zero for deterministic Q
Same zero-residual issue under deterministic Q; stochastic re-evaluation is not a specified standard residual either

equations.role: Local final-minus-initial model plus previous error on skipped upload
Mean participating update plus previous server error
equations.issue: S_j defined as a set but used as scalar denominator; cardinality and empty-participation policy unspecified

Sum transmitted parameter bits over uploading clients and epochs

data_audit.source_description: Chinese Society of Power Engineering regional load, 2009-2015; footnote shumo.nedu.edu.cn
data_audit.missing: Exact dataset file/version, region, sampling frequency, number of observations, timestamps of split, source checksum
data_audit.split: 4:1 generated-window split; chronological versus randomized split not stated
data_audit.clients: Training data randomly allocated with similar data amounts; not demonstrated real consumer partitions
data_audit.risk: Outlier replacement uses following observation and normalization is described before splitting. Information availability and train-only fitting require clarification; leakage is a risk, not demonstrated fact.
data_audit.test_use: Preliminaries allow test-loss stopping or preset iterations; experiments report 100 epochs, so adaptive test-based stopping is not proven.

statistics.statistical_unit: Not explicitly defined for inferential analysis; epochs are not independent experimental repetitions
statistics.effect_size: Reviewer recomputed relative communication savings from rounded table cells only
statistics.convergence: Visual curve behavior, not formal or probabilistic convergence guarantee
statistics.privacy: No attack evaluation, differential privacy parameters or secure-aggregation proof; local raw-data retention alone is not a privacy guarantee

cross_section_logic.assessment: Good two-axis decomposition: communication size and frequency lead to modules; residual correction addresses induced bias
Metric omits downlink, weakening mechanism-to-evidence alignment
Printed residual definitions inconsistent with intended nonzero compensation; experiment behavior cannot repair undefined mathematics
No direct privacy or realistic heterogeneity test
Cost/utility tradeoff supported descriptively; safety, guarantee and massive-experiment phrasing stronger than evidence

conclusion_distillation.safe_takeaway: Illustrates protocol-level cost/accuracy tradeoff for a fixed forecasting backbone; does not establish best forecast accuracy, privacy guarantee or convergence theory.

patterns: Separate a bottleneck into two controllable dimensions, assign a module to each, then analyze the induced side effect
Pair resource results with predictive-utility results rather than reporting savings alone
Close with the operational parameters whose theory remains unresolved
language_distillation.avoid: Do not copy distinctive sentences or use guarantees without corresponding theory/evidence
